free_tier.stated: Pay-to-publish (Data Publishing Charge). Up to 5 GB = $150; 1 TB = $6,077; 2 TB = $12,162. Not a free tier in any sense.

egress.terms: Free downloads once published; no egress metering.

tooling: REST API + OAI-PMH; DOI minting; integration with manuscript submission systems.
chaining: None. The fee scales linearly per dataset, so there is no multiplication play — cost per TB is roughly $6,000 and does not fall with volume ($6.08/GB flat from 500 GB to 2 TB).
limits_note: 10 GB per individual file; 300 GB per publication through the web UI; above that it is a negotiated large-data order. Partner institutions sponsor only the first 10 GB, with a Large Data Fee above.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: UI; above that it is a negotiated large-data order. Partner institutions sponsor only the first 10 GB, with a Large Data Fee above. academic

reliability_note: Highly reliable, curated, POSI-signatory, but gated behind a credit-card payment at submission — useless as free bulk storage.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
